items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: that time I think it was Sally Rand was the headline act on the bill

ctx.x: What kind of dancing was he doing?
Same kind, tap dancing. He'd do no tap dancing, same -- no different style.

You got Chez Maurice? The Chez Maurice at which time the billing for Buck and Bubbles was so nil from the lack of management supervision for publicity to be sent to the theater for our appearance that it hurt me in such an extent -- to such an extent that I wanted to make a reason to get out of the contract. Make this sufficient enough to get out of the contract.
